mapper.select:
INSERT INTO places ( external_provider, external_place_id, category, name, country_code, region, city, address, latitude, longitude, description, phone, website_url, is_active ) VALUES ( #{externalProvider}, #{externalPlaceId}, #{category}, #{name}, COALESCE(#{countryCode}, 'KR'), #{region}, #{city}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{description}, #{phone}, #{websiteUrl}, TRUE ) ON CONFLICT (external_provider, external_place_id) DO UPDATE SET category = EXCLUDED.category, name = EXCLUDED.name, address = EXCLUDED.address,
region = COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(places.region), ''), EXCLUDED.region), city = COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(places.city), ''), EXCLUDED.city), latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude, description = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.description, places.description), phone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone, places.phone), website_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.website_url, places.website_url),
updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) RETURNING place_id
SELECT place_image_id, image_url, alt_text, sort_order, is_primary AS primary_image FROM place_images WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY is_primary DESC, sort_order, place_image_id
